lines.en: The caterpillar pushes forward segment by segment.
Its body humps up and flattens out.
It grips a vein and inches along.
It rounds the leaf's edge and changes course.
Its hooks catch the leaf surface firmly.
It reaches the tip and pauses.
It lifts its head to feel the way.

lines.zh: 它从一片叶挪到另一片
lines.en: It crosses from one leaf to the next.

lines.zh: 它的移动慢得几乎看不出
lines.en: Its progress is almost invisible.

lines.zh: 它把身体拉长，又缩回去
lines.en: It stretches out and draws back in.

lines.zh: 它沿着叶背一点点前进
lines.en: It advances along the leaf's underside.
It detours around a droplet.

lines.zh: 它把叶子吃得只剩脉络
lines.en: It eats the leaf down to the veins.

lines.zh: 它停在一片新的嫩叶上
lines.en: It settles on a fresh young leaf.
It rolls over to hang beneath the leaf.

lines.zh: 它向叶脉更密的地方爬
lines.en: It crawls toward the thicker veins.
The caterpillar curls on the leaf, still.
Its head is raised, as if listening.
It chews the leaf flesh slowly.
Its body ripples gently.
It props up its front half.

lines.zh: 阳光透过叶子照在它身上
lines.en: Sunlight comes through the leaf onto it.
Its segments pulse one by one.

lines.zh: 它用足梳理了一下头部
lines.en: It grooms its head with its feet.
It leans along a vein.
A fleck of leaf sticks to its back.
It slowly straightens out.

lines.zh: 它把足一只只重新勾好
lines.en: It resets its feet, one by one.
The caterpillar raises its head at you.
It lifts its front half higher.
Its head sways twice.

lines.zh: 它对你没有反应，继续啃
lines.en: It ignores you and keeps chewing.
You block the light; it shifts aside.
It crawls to the edge of your finger.

lines.zh: 它的足在你皮肤上很轻
lines.en: Its feet tickle lightly on your skin.
It circles once on your hand.

lines.zh: 它对你的热气没什么兴趣
lines.en: Your warmth hardly interests it.
It lowers its head back to the leaf.
The caterpillar curls into a ball.
Its feet scrabble wildly.
It slips half an inch down the leaf.
It pulls itself in tight.

lines.zh: 一小块叶屑沾在伤口上
lines.en: A fleck of leaf sticks to the wound.
It slowly loosens and crawls again.
Its movements are slower now.
It hides deeper along the vein.
It stays curled a long while.

lines.zh: 它还是朝叶子的方向去
lines.en: It still heads for the leaf.

lines.zh: 毛虫朝着叶子的方向爬
lines.en: The caterpillar crawls toward the leaf.
It smells the sap.
It buries its head in the leaf.
It eats fast, segments pulsing.
Its bite carves an arc from the edge.
It moves to the tenderer side.
Done, it lifts its head for the next leaf.

lines.zh: 它对你递的叶子不感兴趣
lines.en: Leaves you offer do not appeal to it.

lines.zh: 它只认那种叶子的味道
lines.en: It only wants that one kind of leaf.
It buries its mouth between the veins.
Nudged, the caterpillar curls up.
It clings to the leaf, gripping hard.
Pushed half a body-width aside.

lines.zh: 它的身体缩成一个弯钩
lines.en: Its body curls into a hook.
Its feet hook around your knuckle.

lines.zh: 它被撞得从叶上滑下去
lines.en: The knock slides it off the leaf.

lines.zh: 它落在另一片叶上，稳住了
lines.en: It lands on another leaf and holds.
It slowly uncurls.
It finds a vein again.

lines.zh: 它继续吃，好像没被碰过
lines.en: It goes on eating as if untouched.

lines.zh: 两条毛虫在同一片叶上
lines.en: Two caterpillars share one leaf.

lines.zh: 它们的头几乎碰在一起
lines.en: Their heads almost touch.

lines.zh: 它们各自啃着自己那侧
lines.en: Each eats its own side.
They drift together and apart.
One crawls over the other.

lines.zh: 它们的身体节律同步了
lines.en: Their body ripples fall into step.
The leaf is eaten down to a skeleton.
They move to a fresh leaf together.

lines.zh: 它们并排挂着，安静下来
lines.en: They hang side by side and go quiet.
One leaf is not enough for two.
The caterpillar clamps the leaf edge.

lines.zh: 它把身体拉过去，一口一口吃
lines.en: It drags itself over and eats bite by bite.
It wraps its feet around the stem.

lines.zh: 它把咬下的叶片拖到身边
lines.en: It hauls the bitten leaf piece near.

lines.zh: 它对你递的东西嗅了嗅
lines.en: It sniffs at what you offer.
It refuses and turns back to leaves.

lines.zh: 它把身体整个埋进叶里
lines.en: It buries itself in the leaf.
It eats a hole clean through.
It pokes its head through the hole.
It crawls on to the next leaf.
The caterpillar lifts its head toward you.
Its front half rears up.

lines.zh: 它把你当成了叶子的边缘
lines.en: It takes you for the leaf's edge.
It starts crawling at your hand.

lines.zh: 它的身体一节节紧起来
lines.en: Its segments tighten one by one.
It stops, as if hesitating.

lines.zh: 它试着咬了一下你的指头
lines.en: It tests a bite on your finger.

lines.zh: 它把叶屑顶到了你手上
lines.en: It nudges leaf crumbs onto your hand.

lines.zh: 它在你手上找不到叶脉
lines.en: It cannot find a vein on your hand.
It slowly starts to crawl again.

lines.zh: 毛虫在你手上转来转去
lines.en: The caterpillar wanders over your hand.

lines.zh: 它找不到可以吃的边缘
lines.en: It finds no edge to eat.
It stretches out to test.
It bites once and draws back.
It passes between your fingers.
It raises its head high.

lines.zh: 它贴住你的皮肤不动了
lines.en: It settles against your skin, still.
Its feet creep closer.
It starts on your cuff.

lines.zh: 它似乎把布料当成了叶子
lines.en: It seems to take cloth for a leaf.
The caterpillar nips you, lightly.
It humps up and bumps you.
Its feet scrape your wrist.
It clamps onto your skin.
It tugs, with very little force.
It rubs leaf crumbs onto your hand.
It tries to haul itself across.
It falls off the leaf and curls tight.
It struggles back onto its feet.
It goes back to gnawing your finger.
Something moves on the leaf's underside.
The caterpillar creeps out along a vein.
Where it has eaten, the leaf is still wet.

lines.zh: 它把身体从前一片叶探过去
lines.en: It stretches across from the last leaf.
It stops and takes a bite.

lines.zh: 一片叶屑从它身上掉下
lines.en: A fleck of leaf falls off it.

lines.zh: 它慢慢把整条身子挪上来
lines.en: It hauls its whole body across.
It curls once at the leaf's centre.
The sun picks it out clearly.

lines.zh: 它开始吃，一切就安静了
lines.en: It begins to eat, and all goes quiet.

lines.zh: 身体被烫得抽搐，它蜷死了
lines.en: Heat convulses it and it curls tight.

lines.zh: 掉在硬地上，它弹了一下
lines.en: It hits hard ground and bounces.

lines.zh: 泡在水里，它扭得越来越慢
lines.en: In water its writhing slows.

lines.zh: 冲击把它掀得翻了几圈
lines.en: The blast tumbles it over and over.

lines.zh: 箭擦过它，把叶子和它一起穿住
lines.en: An arrow pins leaf and larva together.
Odd force sets every segment twitching.

lines.zh: 离了叶子，它的身体软下去
lines.en: Off its leaf, its body goes limp.
Lightning curls it into a hard knot.
The void pulls; its feet still grip.
